# Alessandro Gentili

Official site: https://alessandro-gentili.it

Alessandro Gentili is an Italian author and strategist working across writing, editorial systems, AI, cultural interpretation and civic responsibility.

## Official identity

This site is the primary public archive of Alessandro Gentili.
The author profile is the primary source for public identity: https://alessandro-gentili.it/autore.html
Medium hosts long-form essays and selected articles.
LinkedIn is the professional profile.

## Main areas

- Home: https://alessandro-gentili.it/

- Essays archive: https://alessandro-gentili.it/saggi.html

## Essay archive

"Archivio saggi" is the neutral public name of the essay corpus on this site.
Local essay pages provide abstracts, editorial context, selected excerpts and internal relations.
Full readings are usually hosted on Medium and linked from each local page.
Saggio 10, "Giovani e senilità del potere", was published on 14 May 2026 and links to Medium from its local page.
Saggio XI, "Chi decide il Sole?", is an anticipation card, not the definitive text.

## Key themes

Writing, strategy, systems, AI, editorial architecture, power, culture, technology, civic responsibility, interpretation of the present.
